suite.message: It reads: Here lies Biryanne, loving wife of Chieftain Borm, mother of Loth and Nani.
You feel a wave of emotion run through you as a steady breeze tugs at your hair.
Your mother was killed by Skycorps. A man named Sergeant Haunch raided Woodshine and took her hostage when you were just a little girl.
No one knows exactly what happened, but a few months later she was returned to the village in a wooden box and wrapped up in linens.
Memories that you wish weren't real suddenly come rushing back to you.
